importId.description: The source's id for it: a later import of the same thing updates this one.

name.description: The name, as references use it.

motif.description: The motif in its scrollwork: a book class's ("Berserker", "Mage"). A plain one if left out.

keyStats.description: One or two of STR, DEX, INT, WIL.

saves.description: The save with advantage, and the one with disadvantage.

startingGear.description: Items by name (the books' or a pack's).

mana.description: How the book writes the pool: "(INT×3)+LVL".

manaFormula.description: The pool as a formula of STR, DEX, INT, WIL, KEY and LVL: "INT*3+LVL".

manaFromLevel.description: The level the pool starts at.

casting.description: Spellcasting: the mana pool and the schools the class knows.

max.description: A number, or a formula of STR, DEX, INT, WIL, KEY and LVL: "WIL", "5×LVL".

rolled.description: "spent": rolled with the roll they go into (Judgment Dice); "gained": rolled as you gain them and set aside (Fury Dice).

addTo.description: Rolls they can go into: attack, spell, save, check.

use.description: How many go into one roll: one, any number, or every die held.

keep.description: They stay after the roll (Fury Dice add to every attack while Raging).

on.description: Switched on in the roll dialog from the start.

onWhile.description: Switched on while the hero has this condition: "Raging".

gain.description: Dice gained at once with the sheet's button.

reachOnly.description: Only melee and Reach attacks, not ranged ones.

clearsOnRest.description: Gone after a fight, so empty after a Safe Rest.

byLevel.description: The die from each level on.

rules.description: The class features whose words explain these dice.

maxSteps.description: The most held grows: "add" more from a level, for one subclass only when it names one.

dice.description: For dice: how they're rolled and what they go into. Without it they're a plain count.

spend.description: The word on a number's button: "Heal" (Lay on Hands). "Spend" if left out.

resources.description: What the class panel on the sheet counts: dice, uses, points.

name.description: The row's name: "Rage".

condition.description: The condition it puts on the hero: "Raging".

feature.description: The feature whose words explain it.

level.description: From this level (1 if left out).

states.description: States the class panel switches on and off: Rage puts Raging on the hero.

name.description: The row's name: "Hunter's Mark".

feature.description: The feature whose words explain it.

tip.description: "one Quarry at a time, for a day".

target.description: A target the class panel keeps, one at a time: Hunter's Mark's Quarry.

text.description: The rules text. Markdown is fine.

count.description: How many to choose (1 if left out).

name.description: A name for the lists together: "Combat Abilities".

or.description: Choices offered instead, that can be taken more than once: "+1 max Combat Dice".

choose.description: What the feature has you choose, when its words don't say: the option lists to pick from, how many, and choices that can be taken more than once instead.

count.description: How many different stats get +1 (1 if left out).

increase.description: A stat increase, when the words don't say "+1 STR or DEX": the stats it can go to (STR, DEX, INT, WIL), and how many different ones get +1.

from.description: Schools by name, or one of "known", "new" (a school not known yet) or "any". Any school if left out.

each.description: One for each school the hero knows.

learn.description: Spell schools or Utility Spells it has you learn, when the words don't say: "school" learns a school, "utilities" every Utility Spell of one school, "utility" Utility Spells one by one.

uses.description: Uses between Safe Rests, when the words don't say "(1/Safe Rest)": a number or a formula, "WIL", "2×WIL".

spellTier.description: The highest spell tier the hero casts from this level, when the feature isn't called "Tier 2 Spells".

unlock.description: Option lists it opens, when the words don't say "Unlock Greater Psionic Abilities": picks from a list then offer every tier of it open so far.

lists.description: Option lists it gives every option of ("Chimeric Boons").

utility.description: Schools whose Utility Spells it gives, or "known" for every school the hero knows.

knows.description: What the feature gives outright, when the words don't say "You know all …": every option of some lists, options by name, and every Utility Spell of some schools.

boon.description: It has you choose a boon of this type, when the words don't say "Choose an Epic Boon".

levels.description: What each level brings. A feature called "Subclass" offers the subclass; "Key Stat Increase" with "+1 STR or DEX." raises a stat; "Choose 1 Kindling" picks from the option list of that name. When the words don't say, a feature can: `choose`, `increase`, `learn`, `uses`, `spellTier`, `unlock`, `knows`, `boon`.

optionGroups.description: Lists the class chooses from as it levels ("Savage Arsenal"): a feature saying "Choose 1 …" with the list's name picks from it.

extra.description: The class's own numbers at this level. A name ending in _uses is a limited-use feature: { "blood_maledict_uses": 2 }.

group.description: This feature is one choice of the feature named here ("Ward Stance"), for options not named "Ward Stance: Ember".

choose.description: A feature with options: how many it gives when gained (1 if left out). Each later level that names it in the table gives one more.

known.description: A feature with options: the level table's column (in "extra") that says how many are known at each level, instead: "invocations_known".

add.description: Abilities whose modifiers add to it besides Dex: [CON].

shield.description: A Shield still counts (true if left out).

uses.description: How many: a number, or a formula of ability modifiers, PB and level: "CHA", "Charisma modifier", "PB", "2 + WIS".

min.description: At least this many (1 for "minimum of once").

level.description: The class level it starts at (1 if left out).

reset.description: What brings them all back: a short or a long rest (long if left out).

shortFrom.description: From this level a short rest brings them all back.

shortOne.description: A short rest brings back one.

resources.description: Limited-use features the level table doesn't count, with pips on the sheet.
